blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rocket debris may fall within the designated drop zones in Philippine waters following China’s Long March 12 rocket launch early Saturday, Oct. 10, the Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) warned. According to PhilSA, the Long March 12 rocket was launched at 3:28 a.m. (Philippine standard time) from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center
